description.p: TailScout is a clean, native Rust desktop GUI for Tailscale on Linux, built with GTK4 and libadwaita. No Electron, no bundled browser — just a lightweight GNOME-style client that wraps the Tailscale CLI and LocalAPI.

ul.li: View and manage all tailnet devices
Connect, disconnect, and check connection status
Switch between Tailscale accounts and tailnets
Device detail popovers with IPs, OS, tags, and last-seen time
Native GTK4/libadwaita UI — matches GNOME style

description.p: Added native Windows and macOS preview clients plus cross-platform release and memory checks.
Admin Console moved to Overview. Polished copyable output/error windows. Improved device-detail popover. Cleaner one-line installer.
Scrollable device-detail popover, Admin Console access, improved permission dialogs.
Initial release. Native GTK4 + libadwaita GUI for Tailscale. Device list, connect/disconnect, Taildrop, exit nodes, account switching.
